messages.subject: [Rpy] doBy
messages.body_plain:
Is there a package I can install (on debian) that will allow me to run
a R script that uses doby with rpy2?

If I try that it fails with:

there is no package called 'doBy'

messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-2.9.1 released and on Pypi
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-2.9.1 is out.
At the time of writing the automated build of the documentation on
ReadTheDocs is still not fixed. Use the backup static builds here:
https://rpy2.github.io/doc/v2.9.x/html/changes.html#release-2-9-1

Best,

Laurent
